{{Top|leg}}
'''New Year Fete Week''' was the first five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the new [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as determined by the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], but before the first [[Standard month/Legends|month]].

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|rule]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was opened with the famed [[Shaldania Parade]] and included a variety of festivities. From at least [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]], the celebrations on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] included the public execution of convicted "Enemies of the Empire," but went private by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

A parade was also done by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], with the [[Imperial Palace Guard]] opening the parade.
